items.headline: Supreme Court blocks Trump's mail ballot restrictions ahead of the 2026 midterms
items.summary: The Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration's bid to let the Postal Service enforce new restrictions on mail-in ballots, in a seven to two order that keeps a lower court's block in place. The court said the administration was unlikely to succeed on the merits of its case, with even one Trump appointee joining the majority.
items.why_it_matters: The ruling keeps mail voting rules unchanged for tens of millions of voters just as the midterm elections are already underway.
